text:
```yaml
name: Build and Release Plugin

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

jobs:
  build-release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: npm

      - name: Install Node.js dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build assets
        run: npm run build

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: '8.3'
          extensions: mbstring, json, zip
          coverage: none
          tools: composer

      - name: Install PHP dependencies
        run: composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader --prefer-dist --no-interaction

      - name: Prepare distribution
        run: |
          mkdir -p dist
          rsync -av --exclude-from=.distignore . dist/
          cd dist
          zip -r ../plugin-${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}.zip .

      - name: Upload release asset
        uses: cli/cli@v2
        with:
          args: release upload ${{ github.event.release.tag_name }} plugin-${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}.zip --repo ${{ github.repository }}
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
